directive.thread_id: launch-video port, audio-sound lane: character voice lines and staging
directive.quote: finish the source-repo-a port so the repo can be retired

targets.baseline_commit_message: measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging: the character-cast scripts of source-repo-a, byte for byte

preserve: yin pitch at 8 kHz with a periodicity voicing test above 0.6 and loudness above the 30th percentile
runs in the band of at least 0.5 s, merged over 1.2 s gaps, kept when half their voiced frames are in the band
allowed_deltas: the band is the person's settings
one JSON request in, one JSON answer out
banned_substitutions: pyin instead of yin with the periodicity test
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash) and by line ranges: the lines left out held a show, a character or a person by name, a video id or a private path, and became the person's settings or the request's folders.
